_note: Bronze / Silver / Gold share one PSD -- only the colour layers differ -- so these three layouts carry identical coordinates. Field centres are the dark value bars *below* each baked-in label, measured off the artwork (2121x3000). Nudge in pixels if a value sits high or low.
fill_note: Value bars are dark, so glyphs are a white->light-grey gradient with a thin dark outline. `color` is the fallback when `gradient` is removed.
